description: Your observatory database contains the 2024-01-01 Noto Peninsula M7.5 mainshock, but the M6.2 aftershock from the same day is missing and needs to be added and reviewed. A QuakeML file for the aftershock has been placed at /home/ga/Desktop/aftershock_data.xml. Import this aftershock event into the SeisComP database, then review both events. For the aftershock event, ensure its event type is set to 'earthquake' and its preferred magnitude type is set to 'Mw(mB)'. Finally, export a formatted event bulletin containing both events to /home/ga/Desktop/event_comparison.txt. The bulletin must include both the M7.5 mainshock and the M6.2 aftershock with their magnitudes and locations.
